business_domain: customer service; governance of an LLM-based assistant with retrieval
organization_goal: offer fast, correct, and accountable answers to customers

it_goals.text: AI assistant answers are correct and accountable

kpis.text: Answers rated correct in the monthly evaluation
Answers citing an approved source document
Answers on topics outside the approved corpus that are escalated to a human agent

tasks: Retrieve answers only from the approved policy corpus
Escalate out-of-scope questions to a human agent
Run a monthly evaluation on a fixed test set
beliefs: Customers act on the assistant's answers
constraints: The assistant does not give answers that commit the company financially

kpis.text: Model or prompt changes recorded and approved before release
Risk assessment of the assistant reviewed

tasks: Keep a model and prompt change register
Review the AI risk assessment with the risk committee
constraints: Customer personal data is not sent to the model provider beyond the session

contribution_values.element: Escalate out-of-scope questions to a human agent

rational_statements.text: A change register makes every model or prompt change attributable, which the evaluation KPI depends on.

conflicts_and_resolutions.conflict: broader corpus would answer more questions but include unapproved drafts
conflicts_and_resolutions.resolution: only approved documents enter the corpus; coverage gaps are filled by escalation
